meta.name: apps
meta.description: Find, compare, and organize mobile apps with personalized recommendations and preference tracking.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现和整理适合你的移动应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常需要查找、比较手机应用并获得个性化推荐。
copy.tagline_en: Find and organize mobile apps with personalized recommendations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to find and compare mobile apps and want personalized recommendations.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的偏好推荐手机应用，比较同类应用的优缺点，并记录你喜欢、试过或想试的应用，所有信息保存在本地文件中。
howto.when: 当你问“推荐某个类型的应用”、“比较两款应用”或“帮我整理应用列表”时，Claude 会触发此技能。

say.text: 我想找一款免费的任务管理应用，iOS 平台。
say.note: Claude 会检查偏好文件后推荐 3 款并说明优缺点。

say.text: 比较一下 Notion 和 Obsidian 作为笔记应用。
say.note: Claude 会按相同类别使用一致标准对比并指出适用场景。

say.text: 帮我把我试过的修图应用都记下来。
say.note: Claude 会更新 tried.md 文件并询问评价。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can recommend mobile apps based on your preferences, compare pros and cons of similar apps, and track your favorites, tried apps, and wishlist, storing data locally.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for app recommendations, comparisons, or help organizing your apps, covering iOS and Android.

say_en.text: Find me a free task management app for iOS.
say_en.note: Claude checks memory and recommends top 3 with tradeoffs.

say_en.text: Compare Notion and Obsidian for note-taking.
say_en.note: Claude uses consistent criteria and declares use-case winners.

say_en.text: Log the photo editing apps I've tried.
say_en.note: Claude updates tried.md and asks for your notes.
